content: .{@-यक्ष्मः, -यक्ष्मन्@} {%m.%} ‘consumption of the moon’, pulmonary consumption, consumption in general; राजयक्ष्मपरिहानिराययौ कामयानसमवस्थया तुलाम् <ls>R. 19. 50</ls>; राजयक्ष्मेव रोगाणां समूहः स महीभृताम् <ls>Śi. 2. 96</ls>; (for explanation of the word see <ls>Malli.</ls> thereon, as well as on <ls>Śi. 13. 29</ls>).
